# API functions whose msgpack-RPC dispatch wrapper is generated by
# tools/apigen. One line per function; everything else about the wrapper is
# read off the Rust signature in crates/nvim/src/nvim/api/.
#
#   <name> [flag ...] [key=value ...]
#
# Flags — upstream's FUNC_API_* markers, which the transpile did not carry
# into the Rust tree:
#
#   textlock               refuse while the text is locked
#   textlock_allow_cmdwin  refuse under textlock, tolerate the cmdline window
#
# Keys:
#
#   argN=<type>  the declared type name to name in a "Wrong type for argument
#                N" message, for parameters whose C declaration carried a
#                decoration Rust cannot express (ArrayOf(Integer, 2) is a
#                plain Array here). Underscores stand for spaces.
#
# The list is being migrated a batch at a time; the wrappers not named here
# are still the transpiled ones in api/private/dispatch.rs.

nvim__id
nvim__id_array
nvim__id_dict
nvim__id_float
nvim_buf_delete textlock
nvim_buf_get_lines
nvim_buf_get_name
nvim_buf_is_valid
nvim_get_api_info
nvim_get_current_buf
nvim_get_mode
nvim_set_current_line textlock_allow_cmdwin
nvim_tabpage_is_valid
nvim_win_get_config
nvim_win_set_cursor arg2=ArrayOf(Integer,_2)
